title: Cellar and Well
author: Odile Sterling
blurb: Noor Sterling, a radio host taking calls from listeners who died last week, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. Then every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must get the family out ahead of the count before the last resident signs the papers.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
